## Why visit

A worthwhile companion to Old Wellington for its timber-framed presence and focused Samuel Smith offering. This is a different proposition from the rotating-cask specialists: the interest is a familiar traditional brewery beer in a distinctive central setting. It works best as one considered stop within the cathedral/Shudehill route, rather than a reason to sacrifice a whole specialist-beer session. The house approach also favours putting the phone away and enjoying the pub, so plan navigation and notes before settling in.

## Beer

The current CAMRA entry explicitly lists cask Old Brewery Bitter; outdated claims that no cask is sold should not be repeated.

## Plan the visit

CAMRA reports the Samuel Smith no-phones/no-tech house policy. Outdoor drinks may use plastic glasses. Do not confuse the rebuilt setting with an intact historic pub interior.

**Getting there:** Adjacent to Old Wellington, near Victoria and Exchange Square.

Check [November transport issues](../logistics.md) for date-specific disruption.
